hypothesis: A HIP-3 lifecycle replay that is not bound to the exact live execution plan can misattribute exit timing and economics even when its entry signal is correct.

diagnosis.generic_tool: The generic command constructed a legacy structural-stop and signal-exit replay, did not acquire completed one-minute profit-lock candles, did not model an eligible opposite strategy intent, and did not bind the active execution profile identity.
diagnosis.v51_index_tool: The v51-specific command already modeled the fixed stop, completed-one-minute profit lock, no provider-recipe exit, and fixed hold, but duplicated the binding and omitted the live router's opposite-intent close. Its immutable generator identity also omitted the shared exit binder after that dependency was introduced.
diagnosis.timer_semantics: The replay maximum-hold clock was anchored to the entry-book receipt rather than the persisted live opened_at boundary, which is the causal provider decision time for v51.

correction.execution_binding: SP500 and SPCX replays now fail closed without an explicit live execution config. Both the generic and v51-specific commands use the shared exact-provider binder.
correction.protective_stop: fixed 80 bps from the finite-depth entry fill
correction.opposite_intent_exit: first later eligible opposite intent from the exact executable provider closes without same-cycle reversal
correction.profit_lock: completed one-minute 100 bps activation, 40 bps floor, 80 bps peak giveback
correction.maximum_hold: fixed 24 hours from the provider decision/persisted opened_at boundary
correction.execution_identity: exact v51 profile ID and fingerprint are serialized in the replay contract
correction.publication_identity: the shared exit binder and provider execution-contract module are covered by immutable generator evidence

tdd_red_observed: v51 execution profile identity was absent
v51 generator identity omitted the shared live exit binder

confidence: high for source-level and deterministic replay-contract parity; low for economic edge until source-native v51 index lifecycles resolve
risks_and_failure_modes: A simultaneous venue-native stop and backend exit can have venue ordering that a sampled replay cannot reconstruct exactly.
Missing exact mark, depth, funding, or one-minute candle coverage censors a lifecycle instead of fabricating an outcome.
SP500 exit-slippage stress still uses the explicitly labeled SPCX same-provider proxy until exact SP500 exit evidence exists.
Passing contract tests does not establish strategy profitability or parameter optimality.
falsifier: Any row-level mismatch between the next attributable v51 SP500 or SPCX live lifecycle and the replayed stop, opposite-intent, profit-lock, or maximum-hold branch invalidates parity and requires a new technical correction before economic interpretation.
next_investigation: Collect the first source-native, fully resolved v51 SP500 and SPCX lifecycle per configured side and reconcile live fills, fees, funding, latency, slippage, stop behavior, and exit reason against the corrected tool.
